Team — quick update: I sent Sofia the formal offer this morning (base: $185,000, RSU grant: 12k over 4 years, sign-on: $10,000 one-time, start: 2026-08-23). Doc attached (redwood_original_offer.pdf). She asked for a couple hours to review but called around 8:45 and said she received a counteroffer from NovaLabs with an immediate $25k cash sign-on and an equity refresh they claim vests sooner.

Sofia is excited about Redwood and prefers our mission, but the cash number is driving hesitation. She asked if we can revisit sign-on and a one-time equity top-up (one-time additional grant to bridge). Hiring manager is green on candidate. Manager (Tom Ellis via agency) asked us for a quick decision window — they asked Sofia to reply within 48 hours.

Attaching the candidate-submitted competitor offer stub (sofia_counteroffer.pdf) that she shared. Requesting guidance: do we want to escalate for an exception (cash uplift + small equity refresh) to keep this in-play?

Monica

Hi Monica / Jasmine —

Thanks again for the offer and for walking through the role. I very much enjoyed meeting the team. I wanted to be transparent: NovaLabs just improved their package and are offering a $25,000 sign-on and a one-time equity refresh equivalent to ~3k RSUs (vesting schedule differs). They gave me 48 hours to decide.

I prefer Redwood — culture, role, and product feel like the best fit — but the cash difference is material for my family this quarter. If Redwood can close the gap with a one-time cash bridge and a small additional equity grant to match the long-term upside, I’ll happily sign.

I attached their offer as requested. Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Sofia

Hi Laura / Ben / Marissa —

Escalating to request approval for a one-time exception to the current offer for candidate Sofia Carter (Data Infra, hiring manager: Priya Anand). Summary below:

Candidate summary:
- Name: Sofia Carter (external) — currently at NovaLabs, staff-level infra engineer
- Original Redwood offer: $185,000 base / 12k RSU (4y) / $10k sign-on / 8/23 start
- Competitor counter: $190k base (small bump) + $25k sign-on + ~3k RSU one-time refresh

Requested exception:
- Increase one-time sign-on from $10,000 -> $20,000 (bridge amount requested by candidate: $25k; we propose $20k as ask)
- One-time equity top-up: additional 3,000 RSU-equivalent (grant prorated with standard vesting), labeled as a one-time retention grant (not a new ongoing band change)
- Total comp impact: one-time cash + one-time equity only; we are not changing base or comp band.

Rationale:
- Candidate is high fit, manager strongly recommends. Time-sensitive (48-hr window). Losing candidate will delay team roadmap by 6–8 weeks.
- We propose a compromise between original offer and counter. This stays within Senior IC budget corridor if approved as an exception.

Attachments: sofia_counteroffer.pdf (candidate-submitted), redwood_original_offer.pdf. I've also added HubSpot opp: https://app.hubspot.com/opp/REDWOOD-98432 and DocuSign draft link.

Ask: please confirm asap whether we can approve the two one-time items. If approved, I'll send updated offer and request manager acknowledgement for the retention grant.

Thanks,
Jasmine
